# Fantasy Maps

Fantasy maps: an illustrated map of a world you invent, for tabletop games, novels and campaigns, with kingdoms, coasts, mountains, forests, rivers and your place names.

## What it does
Describe the world and list the place names. Claude tells you the price and draws the map in the style you pick, such as parchment or ink.

**How the files are made:** each fantasy map is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Original worlds only, not maps of existing books, films or games. The lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install fantasy-maps@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Fantasy Maps talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/fantasy-map/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each fantasy map uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The fantasy maps show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_fantasy_map_models` | Models for fantasy maps with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_fantasy_map_cost` | Exact price of one fantasy map before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_fantasy_map` | Starts one fantasy map in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_fantasy_map` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Draw a parchment map of an island kingdom called Varn"
- "Make a fantasy map with three kingdoms and a desert in the south"
- "Create an ink map of a mountain realm for my campaign"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the fantasy map (the world, place names and style you describe) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
